original_test_intent: Stress the mapped GB-NV-PVP PCIe link with exactly 10,000 intentional disable/enable transactions and prove every re-enabled endpoint returns at required width/speed without new PCIe or platform errors.
original_method: Approve the exact link-control primitive and hierarchy; baseline endpoint/link/errors; for each numbered cycle durably record disable acknowledgement, expected endpoint absence, enable request, LTSSM/re-enumeration, settled gen/width, and error/health result before permitting the next cycle; stop on first anomaly and recover out of band.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE approves link-control scope and endpoint disappearance; an operator isolates the SUT, monitors out-of-band state, and owns recovery from a stranded endpoint or host.
required_inputs: Pinned NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual link enable/disable configuration
Disable/enable primitive, expected absence, re-enumeration, gen/width, and timing rules
10,000-cycle count, durable checkpoint/storage, error-delta, abort, final-state, and recovery policy
safety_requirements: Dedicated non-production SUT and explicit 10,000-cycle approval
No unsaved workload and verified out-of-band console
Bound control to approved link hierarchy
Stop on failed disable/enable, unexpected scope, missing endpoint, late/reduced retrain, new AER, GPU/host reset, thermal/power anomaly, or logging gap
No forced recovery or automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate target, mechanism, baseline, interlocks, and ledger
Commit each complete transaction before the next cycle
Correlate endpoint/link/error/platform state and inhibit on fault
Do not infer target, force a lost link, continue after evidence loss, retry, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve link-control primitive, scope, and 10,000-cycle risk
Review ledger and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It identifies the tool family but lacks an exact link-control operation and cannot prove 10,000 successful disable/enable transactions with a final lspci/dmesg sweep.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the pinned control primitive with an atomic monotonic ledger and a hard interlock preventing cycle N+1 until N's disable, absence, enable, retrain, link, and error results are durable and accepted.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: LTSSM, exactly 10,000 link disable/enable cycles, required width/speed, no errors, no bundle, and 60/2880-minute allocation remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat each link cycle as a complete disappearance-and-recovery transaction with durable topology, timing, link, and error evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines target scope, expected absence, re-enumeration, evidence durability, first-fault handling, and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final present endpoint cannot reveal missing cycles, transient failures, sibling disruption, downtraining, or earlier AER events.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong hierarchy or uncontrolled cycling can repeatedly remove GPUs/siblings, reset the host, exhaust logs, or strand the link.

project_override_considerations: Do not count setup, retries, or partial cycles. Checkpoint compression is acceptable only if lossless and gap-detecting; it must preserve first-fault chronology and tool restarts.
expected_evidence: Pinned tool/configuration plus full target/sibling topology
Monotonic 1-10000 lossless ledger with timestamps and complete transaction status
First-fault recovery or clean final endpoint/link/host state and engineer verdict

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2117 Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00038-V002: approve the exact LTSSM/NVQual link disable/enable primitive and root-port/bridge/endpoint/sibling scope, expected absence/re-enumeration/gen/width deadlines, exact 10,000-cycle/checkpoint rules, acceptable AER/error deltas, first-fault interlocks, final state, and out-of-band recovery.

review_improvement: Preserves the extreme cycle count while making every endpoint disappearance/recovery traceable and preventing a reset storm from continuing after the first fault.
independent_technical_reasoning: Link disable/enable is more disruptive than speed negotiation because the endpoint can disappear from enumeration and the control channel itself may be affected. Cycle N+1 is valid only after N proves the intended link alone went down, the endpoint returned within deadline at full width/speed, and error/platform state remained acceptable. A final snapshot cannot establish that history. Durable commit-before-next-cycle interlocking is therefore both the evidence model and the primary safety control.
